description: Restricted RFC 8785 JCS positive/negative vectors (incl. depth 16/17/1000 & leading-zero), 3 hashes, clause_commit, BIP-340 SignatureSet, and strict cofactorless Ed25519 + low-S NIST P-256 device-key signature checks.

jcs_positive.notes: UTF-16 code-unit key order places U+1F512 (D83D DD12) before U+E000 (E000).
LF is permitted on the exact typed path seallink-card/1 role (x-seallink-allow-lf).
Exact container nesting depth 16 MUST be accepted (only container depth > 16 refuses WIRE_SIZE).

three_hashes_and_signatureset.invariance_note: Both 2-of-3 subsets share identical object_id and signing_digest, while content_addr differs.
